# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Project Overview

Synthwave '84 is a color theme extension for the Zed editor with four variants: Classic, Soft, High Contrast, and Delta.

## Architecture

**Source files** (edit these):
- `src/base.json` - Theme structure, UI templates with `{{color}}` placeholders, syntax token-to-color mappings
- `palette.json` - All color definitions organized by variant

**Generated** (do not edit directly):
- `themes/synthwave84.json` - Built from source files via `make generate`

## Commands

```bash
make generate   # Build theme from source
make validate   # Check structure and WCAG contrast ratios
make check      # Verify theme matches source (CI uses this)
make derive     # Show programmatically derived variant colors
make coverage   # Check Zed syntax token coverage
make all        # generate + validate
```

To apply derived colors: `python3 scripts/theme.py derive --apply`

## Pre-commit Hook

```bash
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
```

Auto-regenerates theme when `src/base.json` or `palette.json` change.

## Color System

`palette.json` structure:
- `base` - Shared backgrounds, borders, foreground (used by all variants)
- `syntax` - Token colors for Classic variant
- `variants.<name>` - Color overrides per variant; may also override `players`

Variants are declared in `src/base.json` under `variants` (name + line number alpha);
`scripts/theme.py` reads that list, so adding one needs no code change.

Two kinds of variant exist:
- **Derived** (`soft`, `high_contrast`) - lightness shifts of the base palette, listed
  in `VARIANT_ADJUSTMENTS` and regenerated by `make derive`:
  - Soft: +6L lightness shift, 4.5:1 minimum contrast
  - High Contrast: -8L lightness shift, 7.0:1 minimum contrast
- **Standalone** (`delta`) - carries its own hues, overriding every background, syntax,
  and terminal key. Absent from `VARIANT_ADJUSTMENTS`, so `make derive` skips it
  rather than overwriting its palette.

## Syntax Token Mapping

In `src/base.json`, the `syntax_colors` object maps tokens to palette keys:

| Palette Key | Classic | Tokens (examples)                    |
|-------------|---------|--------------------------------------|
| function    | cyan    | function, constructor, variant       |
| heading     | cyan    | title, markup.heading, entity.name.section |
| keyword     | yellow  | keyword, operator, attribute         |
| declaration | pink    | storage.type, keyword.function, label, preproc |
| string      | orange  | string, text.literal                 |
| type        | pink    | type, enum, entity.name.type         |
| variable    | pink    | variable, property, support.type.property-name |
| tag         | pink    | tag, entity.name.tag, JSXOpeningElement |
| markup      | pink    | emphasis, markup.bold, markup.italic |
| list        | pink    | markup.list, punctuation.list_marker |
| constant    | coral   | constant, constant.language, support.constant |
| number      | coral   | number, boolean, constant.numeric    |
| parameter   | coral   | variable.parameter                   |
| comment     | muted   | comment, markup.quote                |
| success     | mint    | support.class, string.escape         |
| info        | blue    | hint, link_text                      |
| error       | red     | keyword.other.unsafe                 |
| foreground  | white   | punctuation, embedded, source.*      |

Keys sharing a Classic color (e.g. `type`/`variable`/`tag`/`markup`/`list` are all
pink) exist so variants can reassign them independently. Delta does; Soft and High
Contrast keep them aligned.

Font styles are defined separately in `syntax_styles` (italic, bold, underline).

A Zed syntax highlight style exposes only `background_color`, `color`, `font_style`,
and `font_weight`, and `font_style` is limited to `normal | italic | oblique`. So
`scripts/theme.py:style_attrs` maps the groups accordingly:

| Group     | Emitted                              |
|-----------|--------------------------------------|
| italic    | `font_style: "italic"`               |
| normal    | `font_style: "normal"`               |
| bold      | `font_weight: 700` (not a font_style)|
| underline | nothing -- Zed cannot express it here|

The `underline` group is kept as declarative intent but is currently inert.
`make validate` rejects any `font_style` outside Zed's enum.
